text: 删去“跨周期”、加码稳汇率，央行例会措辞变化释放什么信号？ 货币政策出现一些边际变化，释放出更重逆周期调节、政策集成、结构引导和预期管理的信号。
text_en: Removing 'cross-cycle', stepping up efforts to stabilize the exchange rate: What signal does the change in wording at the PBOC's regular meeting release? Monetary policy has shown some marginal changes, sending signals of greater emphasis on countercyclical adjustment, policy integration, structural guidance and expectation management.
